title: yo dhammaṃ passati
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
(Sāriputta:)
“Now this has been said by the Blessed One:
‘One who sees dependent origination sees Dhamma;
one who sees Dhamma sees dependent origination.’”
